thesis: The episode argues that Moderna is a platform company capable of developing thousands of therapeutics and vaccines, rather than being limited to a single drug. The speaker emphasizes that the company has transitioned into a nucleic acid delivery platform to maximize impact on disease through industrialized, designed efforts. Additionally, the discussion notes that Moderna actively manages four specific risks to position itself as the best version of the company.

claims.claim: The speaker believes MRNA vaccines will work and that the company has a platform to develop many drugs, not just one.
claims.quote: Because for 10 years, you know, Rore, we hoped that MRA vaccines were going to work. We believe scientifically they were going to work, but until you have a phase three randomized placebo control study where you test really prevention of disease, you don't know. Now we know.

claims.claim: The speaker describes Moderna as a platform company capable of developing thousands of drugs rather than being a one-drug company.
claims.quote: What was very clear to us because MRN is an information molecule is he made no scientific sense that this will be a one drug company. It would be either zero because we run out of money before we can safely get a drug approved or it would be a company with thousands and thousands and dozens and dozens of drugs because of a platform.

claims.claim: The speaker notes that Moderna has become a delivery of nucleic acid company to maximize impact on disease.
claims.quote: We realize that what would allow us to maximize the impact we could have on disease or helping as many people as we can over the next five, 10, 10, 20 years is the ability to bring to different cell type.

claims.claim: The speaker highlights that Moderna's technology allows for industrialized, designed efforts to create therapeutics or vaccines.
claims.quote: And that's this incredibly powerful paradigm, you know, to taking therapeutics or vaccines from being very bespoke efforts to being truly industrialized, designed efforts.

claims.claim: The speaker mentions that Moderna has four risks they manage to have the best chance to be the best version of Moderna.
claims.quote: We ended up zooming on four risks that we say if we can manage and reduce those risks, we will have a best chance to be the best version of Moderna.
